title: Ballinagare, Castlerea, Co. Roscommon, F45RX00
description:
REA Seamus Carthy are delighted to present this recently refurbished four-bedroom terraced townhouse, ideally located in a convenient village setting. Bright and spacious accommodation comprises living room, open-plan kitchen/dining room, utility, shower room, home office, four bedrooms including one ensuite, and family bathroom. A standout feature is the private rear garden, enclosed by high natural stone walls and featuring traditional stone outbuildings, with double gates providing valuable vehicular access. Presented in excellent condition and offering vacant possession immediately, this is a superb opportunity for those seeking a spacious, ready-to-move-into home with excellent outdoor space. Viewing strongly recommended. Contact REA Seamus Carthy today.
